## Config
offset(x=-4040000, y=-15140000, line_width=6)

## File description
* ssd4gnss.csv : Extracted gnss data from rosbag
* gnss.osm : ssd4gnss.csv -> osm for gnss2cartesian.py
* gnss.xodr : lat, lon -> carla map coordinate
* map.osm : OSM map
* opendrivemap.xodr : OpenDriveMap generated by generate_map.py
* test_data.json : Manually extracted from rosbag (1634510 - 1634530). Gnss is also manually converted.
* out.json : Convert raw data (position, speed) to carla coodinate using convert_raw_data.py
